name: nextly
description: AI tool to instantly generate Next.js apps from prompts. #1 lovable clone for developers and non-coders to prototype faster with next.js magic!

paragraphs: AI-powered Next.js application generator that transforms natural language prompts into production-ready code. From concept to deployment, skip the boilerplate and focus on what makes your project unique.
features: ⚡ Prompt-to-Code Next.js Apps Transform natural language descriptions into complete Next.js applications with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS. No templates, no restrictions.
🎯 Unlimited Free AI Generation Powered by Grok 4 during beta. Generate as many applications as you need without hitting usage limits or paywalls.
✨ No AI Boilerplate Clean, idiomatic Next.js code without generic AI patterns. Every generation feels intentional, structured, and ready for real-world projects.
🌐 Instant Live Preview Every generation deploys automatically through e2b.app. Get a live demo URL instantly to test and share your application without configuration.
🔄 Iterative Development Refine your application through conversational prompts. Add features, adjust layouts, or fix issues without rewriting from scratch.

whatItDoes.text: AI-powered Next.js application generator that transforms natural language prompts into production-ready code. From concept to deployment, skip the boilerplate and focus on what makes your project unique.
